purpose: Hash-bound successor execution contract for canonical C1-LVA dual-MC1 scoring. This file has no exchange authority and must fail closed until the declared current-month C1 mapper and upstream dual-coordinate score producer are sealed.

c1_lva.required_population: the exact Router50 target-free population; BCF and Current coordinate identities must match exactly; C1 snapshot absence is a mapper input, not a candidate filter

admission.rule: BCF C1-MC1 expected net >= 50 bps AND Current C1-MC1 expected net >= 50 bps

execution.execution_adjusted_ev_formula: raw_expected_gross_bps = bcf_c1_mc1_expected_net_bps + 100; execution_adjusted_ev_bps = raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_only_delay_gap_bps - (1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_vwap_impact_bps + 10 bps buffer). No 80-bps friction floor is applied.
execution.order_of_operations: dual C1-MC1 admission -> normal portfolio auction -> live ticker and order-book preflight -> execution-adjusted EV and price-gap veto -> submit

terminal_telemetry.contract: Every confirmed terminal trade must preserve the immutable entry prediction and execution economics together with fee-confirmed realised net bps before it may enter an execution-adjusted calibration map.
terminal_telemetry.outcome_field: pnl.net_bps only when pnl.fees_verified is true

required_before_exchange_activation: An immutable current-month C1 BCF and Current mapper package index with strict prior-resolved six-month training.
A current append-only C1 state checkpoint and completed-15-minute snapshot materializer.
A restored or freshly sealed P8U upstream score bundle that persists independent target-free BCF coordinates alongside Current routed scores.
A no-order end-to-end parity receipt for the exact current source, C1 snapshot, dual maps, admission, auction, and execution preflight inputs.
A separate exchange-writing activation receipt binding this successor's hashes.
live_readiness.failure_mode: fail closed; no fallback to the non-C1 MC1 mapper or a previous-month C1 package
